neighbours.label: text about gene and genome structure (coding vs non-coding regions of DNA/RNA), strongest just before '-coding'
fire: Each gene in the virus is flanked by short non-coding regions that control expression.
Most of the human genome is non-coding DNA, and only a small fraction encodes proteins.
The chloroplast genome holds about 80 protein-coding genes and many non-coding spacers.
Long non-coding RNAs can regulate nearby genes without being translated.
In yeast, a large share of the genome consists of coding sequences with few introns.
The transcript has a long 3' untranslated region after the stop codon of the ORF.
Mutations in non-coding regulatory DNA can still change how a gene is expressed.
Researchers compared exons and introns across the coding sequence of the gene.
quiet: Each cell in the tissue is flanked by thin membranes that control nutrient flow.
Most of the human body is water, and only a small fraction is bone mineral.
The chloroplast contains stacks of thylakoids and many small starch grains.
Certain hormones can regulate nearby cells without entering the bloodstream.
In yeast, a large share of the cell volume is taken up by vacuoles with few granules.
The engine has a long exhaust pipe after the second chamber of the turbine.
Changes in soil acidity can still change how a crop grows in the field.
Researchers compared leaves and roots across the life cycle of the plant.

predictions: fire 0.3-1.5 on genome-structure sentences; near misses outside sequence biology near 0
notes: Card peaks on function words inside sentences about coding DNA, UTRs, ORFs, non-coding RNAs; logit effect of the + pole suppresses ' coding', ' non', ' untranslated'. Probe: 'short non-coding control region' 1.543 (peak ' non'), 'proportion of coding DNA and few' 0.872, 'non-protein-coding RNA' 0.723, UTR/ORF 0.501, mtDNA phylogenies 0.343; parallel non-genetic sentences 0.002-0.003. Near misses keep the sentence shapes and scientific register (cell biology, physiology, engineering) but drop gene/sequence structure.
